MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026 Out mpsc.gov.in

MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026 has been released on the official website @mpsc.gov.in. candidates can now check whether they have qualified for the next stage of the recruitment process i.e., Mains exams. The result is available in PDF format for easy access. Aspirants should verify their roll numbers in the list of shortlisted candidates.

MPSC Prelims Result 2026 Link

MPSC Prelims Result 2026 has been announced in PDF format on the official website. Candidates who appeared for Prelims exam on 31 May 2026 can download the result and check their roll numbers. The PDF contains a list of candidates shortlisted for the next stage of the selection process. Candidates can download the MPSC Prelims Result 2026 PDF from below.

How to Check MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates can check MPSC Prelims Result online through the official website. The result is available in PDF format and can be downloaded for future use. Candidates can follow the steps below to download the result

  • Visit the official website @mpsc.gov.in
  • On the homepages click on MPSC Result 2026 link
  • Open the result PDF available on the screen
  • Search for roll numbers using search options
  • Check qualifying status in result list
  • Download result PDF and save for future reference

What’s Next After MPSC Prelims Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify Prelims Result of MPSC Rajyaseva exam will be eligible to appear for mains examination. The mains exam is the next stage of the selection process and plays a crucial role in final selection. Candidates who clear the mains will be called for the interview round. The final merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained in the mains examination and interview, after which selected candidates will be appointed to various Group A and Group B posts.

MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026 Live Updates

Candidates can follow this page for latest updates on MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026. We have provided live updates to help candidates stay informed about the result announcement, cut off marks and further stages of selection process. Any official notification released by Maharashtra Public Service Commission will be updated here promptly. Check below for live updates.

OBC Category Cutoff Touches 98 Marks

The OBC General category cutoff has been fixed at 98 marks, matching the Open category cutoff. Meanwhile, the OBC Female category cutoff has been set at 92 marks, indicating intense competition among candidates across reserved and unreserved categories.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 08:50:24 PM IST

Result Brings Relief to Thousands of Aspirants

The release of the MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026 has ended weeks of anticipation among candidates. Successful aspirants are celebrating their achievement while simultaneously preparing for the challenging Mains Examination that lies ahead.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 08:40:47 PM IST

Merit-Based Selection Continues

The MPSC Rajyaseva recruitment process follows a merit-based selection system. Performance in the Mains Examination and Interview will ultimately determine candidates’ final rankings and allocation to various Maharashtra state services.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 08:30:32 PM IST

Coaching Institutes Release Mains Strategies

Following the result declaration, several coaching institutes have started publishing Mains preparation plans, answer-writing schedules, and subject-wise strategies. Qualified candidates are utilizing this period to strengthen their preparation before the next examination phase.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 08:20:50 PM IST

Document Readiness Recommended for Qualified Candidates

Candidates who have qualified for the Mains stage are advised to keep educational certificates, identity proofs, category certificates, and other relevant documents ready, as these may be required during subsequent stages of the recruitment process.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 08:10:47 PM IST

Aspirants Compare Performance with Previous Years

Candidates are comparing this year’s result trends with previous MPSC Rajyaseva examinations to understand competition levels. Discussions regarding category-wise cutoffs and qualification rates are gaining attention among aspirants preparing for future attempts.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 08:00:06 PM IST

Selection Process Advances to Crucial Phase

The declaration of the MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026 has advanced the recruitment process to a crucial stage. Candidates who clear the Mains Examination will move closer to the interview round and final selection for prestigious administrative positions in Maharashtra.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 07:51:02 PM IST

Candidates Verify Details in MPSC Result PDF

Aspirants are advised to carefully verify their roll numbers and category details in the result document. Any discrepancy should be immediately brought to the notice of the Maharashtra Public Service Commission through official communication channels.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 07:40:18 PM IST

Sports Category Cutoff Details Announced

The cutoff for Open Sports Group-A candidates has been fixed at 40.50 marks, while Open Sports Group-B candidates required 81.50 marks. In the OBC category, the Sports Group-B cutoff has been announced at 75.50 marks.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 07:30:53 PM IST

Competition Remains High in Rajyaseva Recruitment

The MPSC Rajyaseva Examination remains one of Maharashtra’s most competitive state civil service examinations. With thousands of candidates appearing for a limited number of vacancies, qualifying the prelims stage itself is considered a significant achievement.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 07:20:57 PM IST

EWS Category Cutoff Announced

Candidates belonging to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category needed 85.50 marks to qualify for the Mains Examination. The EWS Female category cutoff has been fixed at 78 marks, providing opportunities for candidates across different reservation categories.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 07:10:25 PM IST

SEBC Candidates Face High Competition

The official cutoff for the SEBC General category has been fixed at 98 marks, while the SEBC Female cutoff stands at 92 marks. The figures indicate that competition remained extremely high among candidates seeking qualification for the Mains stage.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 07:00:24 PM IST

Official Website Experiences Heavy Traffic

Soon after the result announcement, a large number of candidates visited the MPSC website to check their status. Due to increased traffic, some users reported slow loading speeds and temporary access issues while downloading the result PDF.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:55:26 PM IST

ST Category Cutoff Drops to 86.5 Marks

For the Scheduled Tribe (ST) General category, the cutoff has been fixed at 86.50 marks, while the ST Female category cutoff stands at 79 marks. Many aspirants believe the cutoff reflects the overall difficulty level of this year’s preliminary examination.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:51:01 PM IST

Mains Exam Preparation Gains Momentum

Thousands of qualified candidates have now shifted their focus toward the MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Examination. Coaching institutes and mentors are advising aspirants to prioritize answer writing, Maharashtra-specific topics, governance, economy, and current affairs preparation.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:45:54 PM IST

Divyang Category-Wise Cutoffs Released

MPSC has also released category-wise cutoffs for Divyang candidates. The cutoff is 81.50 marks for Group A, 57 marks for Group B, 85.50 marks for Group C, and 54 marks for Group D/E. Candidates can now assess their qualification status based on their respective category.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:40:34 PM IST

Cutoff Marks Become Major Discussion Point

Following the declaration of the MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026, candidates are actively discussing expected and official cutoff marks. The cutoff varies across categories and depends on factors such as exam difficulty level, vacancies, and overall candidate performance.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:36:02 PM IST

SC Category Cutoff Recorded at 94 Marks

The Scheduled Caste (SC) General category cutoff has been announced at 94 marks, while the SC Female cutoff is 91 marks. Candidates are comparing these figures with previous years to understand changes in competition levels and selection trends.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:30:51 PM IST

Open Female Category Cutoff Fixed at 92 Marks

According to the official cutoff list, the Open Female category cutoff stands at 92 marks. Female candidates who secured the required cutoff have successfully advanced to the next stage of the recruitment process and can now focus on Mains preparation.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:25:45 PM IST

Result PDF Contains Roll Numbers of Qualified Candidates

The commission has released the result in PDF format, listing the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the next stage. Candidates should carefully check the merit list and download a copy for future reference during the recruitment process.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:21:08 PM IST

Qualified Candidates Move to Mains Stage

Candidates who have successfully cleared the MPSC Rajyaseva Preliminary Examination 2026 are now eligible to appear for the Mains Examination. Aspirants are advised to begin intensive preparation as the Mains stage requires a deeper understanding of subjects and strong answer-writing skills.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:19:48 PM IST

Open Category Cutoff Reaches 98 Marks

The Maharashtra Public Service Commission has released the official cutoff along with the prelims result. For the Open (General) category, the cutoff has been fixed at 98 marks, reflecting strong competition among candidates. Aspirants scoring at or above this mark have qualified for the MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Examination 2026.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:13:43 PM IST

MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026 Declared

The MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026 has been officially declared by the Maharashtra Public Service Commission. Candidates who appeared for the preliminary examination can now check their qualifying status through the result PDF available on the official website. The result marks the beginning of the next phase of the recruitment process.

Updated on: 22 Jun 2026 | 06:12:37 PM IST

MPSC Prelims Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When was the MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Result 2026 released?
The MPSC Prelims Result 2026 released on 22 June 2026 on the official website @mpsc.gov.in

Q2. How can I download the MPSC Prelims 2026 Result PDF?
Candidates can visit mpsc.gov.in and download the result PDF from the latest notifications section.

Q3. What is the next stage after the MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims 2026 Result?
Candidates who qualify the prelims examination will be eligible to appear for the MPSC Rajyaseva Mains Examination.

Q4. What was the MPSC Rajyaseva Prelims Cut Off 2026 for the Open category?
The cut-off for the Open (General) category was 98.00 marks.

Q5. Does the MPSC Result 2026 PDF contain roll numbers or marks?
The result PDF contains the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates. Individual marks are released separately by MPSC.
